hero.subtitle: Magnetic analog switches that read how far you press — not just whether you pressed. Zero lag. Fully customisable. This is what a keyboard should have always been.

products.heading: Same core. Three sizes.
products.subtitle: Every model runs the same magnetic switch engine. The only question is how much desk space you want to give it.

tech.heading: Magnetic, not mechanical.
tech.subtitle: Traditional switches physically touch to register a press. Ours don't. A Hall-effect sensor reads the exact position of every key in real time — so you can set the actuation point wherever you want, and release is detected the instant your finger lifts.

feature1.title: Adjustable actuation
feature1.desc: Set each key to fire anywhere between 0.1 mm and 4.0 mm. Want hair-trigger WASD and deep-press spacebar? Go ahead. Rapid Trigger means the key resets the moment you start lifting — no waiting for a fixed return point.

feature2.title: Sub-millisecond latency
feature2.desc: No debounce algorithm. No matrix scan delay. The sensor reads position continuously and the firmware pushes the signal straight to USB. From finger to frame, the path is as short as physics allows.

feature3.title: Built to outlast you
feature3.desc: No physical contacts means nothing to wear down. Every press is contactless. We rate each switch at 100 million actuations — which is probably longer than you'll keep any single keyboard.

customize.heading: Make it yours.
customize.subtitle: Switches, case, caps — everything swaps. Start with the core you want and build out from there.

waitlist.heading: Get in early.
waitlist.subtitle: We're shipping in small batches. Join the list and we'll let you know when your slot opens — no spam, no nonsense.

success.title: You're on the list.

success.line3: That's it. No drip campaigns, no upsells, just launch updates.
